questions.q: How much did Voyager 2's speed around the Sun change at Jupiter?
questions.do: Voyager 2 is picked at the start. Read Jupiter flyby: speed around the Sun under the speed chart.
questions.a: From 9.6 to 19.7 km/s, a gain of about 10 km/s with no fuel burned. The chart labels it JUPITER +10.0.

questions.q: In "Try one flyby", what changes when you pass in front of Jupiter instead of behind it?
questions.do: Keep Jupiter, 7.9 km/s and 10.10 radii. Read the verdict. Then drag Which side to In front of the planet.
questions.a: Behind the planet: speed around the Sun goes 11.4 to 20.5 km/s, a gain of 9.1 km/s. In front: 11.4 to 8.0 km/s, a loss of 3.4 km/s. The path is bent by 95.1° both times; only the side changes.

questions.q: Which mission got the biggest boost from Jupiter: Voyager 1, Voyager 2 or New Horizons?
questions.do: Click each mission button in turn and read Jupiter flyby: speed around the Sun.
questions.a: Voyager 1: 12.7 to 23.6 km/s (about +10.8). Voyager 2: 9.6 to 19.7 (+10.0). New Horizons: 19.1 to 22.1 (only +3.0). The test table shows New Horizons passed about 2.3 million km from Jupiter, far out, so its path bent much less.

questions.q: Why is the closest-approach table called a "test" of the physics?
questions.do: Read The test: how close did they have to pass? and compare the Real closest approach and Model needs columns.
questions.a: The model is given only the arrival dates, never the real distances, and it predicts them. For Voyager 2 at Saturn it predicts 159,900 km against the real 161,000 km, only 0.7% off. Predicting a number it never saw shows the gravity model is right.

questions.q: Who spotted the rare line-up that made the Grand Tour possible, and when is the next chance?
questions.do: Read When is the next Grand Tour? and the box under the chart (it opens on 1977). Then click the chart near 2155.
questions.a: Gary Flandro at JPL noticed it in 1964; it happens only about once every 175 years. For 1977 the box says a Grand Tour works. The shaded bands show tours on gravity alone only in the late 1970s and early 1980s, and then around 2155, when the box says it works only by threading Saturn, passing inside its rings.
